title: BacklogitDoclineExtensionV1
description:
Model A owner-scoped extension schema for the `backlogit` profile.

This layered extension validates ONLY the `docline.backlogit` subtree and is
composed `allOf` on top of the docline base-frontmatter v1 contract. The base
contract's closed top level (additionalProperties:false) is NOT opened; the
backlogit owner profile lives nested under the open `docline` map at
`docline.backlogit.*`, additive and never enveloping the docline base fields.

Scope: this schema is valid ONLY for docline DOCUMENTS (whose top level satisfies
base-frontmatter v1). It is NOT the contract for .backlogit feature/task/shipment
artifact frontmatter; validating docline.backlogit on .backlogit artifacts would
require a separate backlogit-artifact schema plus an artifact-codec bridge, both
out of scope here and gated on the 109.x spike decision.

Ownership: docline owns and validates only the base fields and preserves the
`docline` map in place; backlogit owns and validates the `docline.backlogit`
subtree via this derived, backlogit-versioned schema.

docline.$comment: No `type` constraint here: the base contract permits `docline` to be `object | null`. Declaring `type: object` would narrow that union and reject base-valid documents whose `docline` is null. JSON Schema `properties` is ignored for non-object instances, so `docline.backlogit` is still constrained whenever `docline` is an object.

backlogit.$comment: Owner profile: backlogit-owned, backlogit-versioned metadata nested under the docline map. Additive-not-enveloping: it adds keys to docline; it never wraps or relocates docline base fields.
backlogit.title: BacklogitOwnerProfile

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the backlogit owner profile contract (per-owner, independent of the docline base schema_version).
